product.olivetti-echos-pro-133-s.summary: The Echos Pro 133 S is identified by its 900T label and interchangeable drives.
product.olivetti-echos-pro-133-s.history: The Museumsstiftung Post und Telekommunikation holds an Echos Pro 133 S from around 1996. It records the commercial name on the screen bezel and type 900T on the lower label.
product.olivetti-echos-pro-133-s.archite: The removable bay could swap the floppy drive for a CD-ROM drive. The museum identifies a 133 MHz Pentium, two card slots and FCC label GXLGP900T.
product.olivetti-echos-pro-133-s.verifie: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-echos-pro-133-s.limitat: Firmware comparison and boot tests are pending.
